results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of Fabio Giglietto's study examining Meta's political content reduction policy, which revealed a 72% reduction in visibility for elected Italian parliamentarians while extremist accounts maintained high reach. The research led to questions in the European Parliament and was featured on Rai3's investigative program Report.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei
results.snippet: News article detailing research led by Professor Fabio Giglietto on how Meta's recommendation algorithms inadvertently suppress official democratic political figures while amplifying fringe and anti-European extremist accounts.

results.title: Algoritmi Meta, più spazio agli estremisti e meno alla politica ufficiale
results.snippet: Media report highlighting independent academic research by Fabio Giglietto that analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts to evaluate Meta's algorithmic transparency and systemic impact on democratic elections.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press release and university news report outlining Fabio Giglietto's paper 'A Pretty Blunt Approach' and its impact on European legislative debates and investigative media coverage.
